name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 25 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-06-26, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.35 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
